mapper.select: select latest.*, j.instance_status as job_instance_status, j.expected_partition_count as expected_partitions, j.success_partition_count as success_partitions, j.failed_partition_count as failed_partitions, j.cancelled_partition_count as cancelled_partitions, j.terminated_partition_count as terminated_partitions, task_counts.created_tasks, task_counts.finished_tasks, current_steps.active_steps from ( select distinct on (n.node_code) n.id, n.node_code, n.node_status, n.run_seq, n.job_instance_id, n.error_code, n.skip_reason_code, n.started_at, n.finished_at from batch.workflow_node_run n join batch.workflow_run r on r.id = n.workflow_run_id where r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and r.id = #{id} order by n.node_code, n.run_seq desc, n.id desc ) latest left join batch.job_instance j on j.id = latest.job_instance_id and j.tenant_id = #{tenantId} left join lateral ( select count(*) as created_tasks, count(*) filter (where t.task_status in ('SUCCESS','FAILED','CANCELLED','TERMINATED')) as finished_tasks from batch.job_task t where t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and t.job_instance_id = latest.job_instance_id ) task_counts on true left join lateral ( select string_agg(distinct active.code, ',' order by active.code) as active_steps from ( select s.stage_code as code from batch.pipeline_instance p join batch.pipeline_step_run s on s.pipeline_instance_id = p.id where p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and p.related_job_instance_id = latest.job_instance_id and p.run_status = 'RUNNING' and s.step_status in ('RUNNING','RETRYING') and not exists ( select 1 from batch.pipeline_step_run newer where newer.pipeline_instance_id = p.id and newer.step_code = s.step_code and (newer.run_seq, newer.id) > (s.run_seq, s.id) ) union all select s.step_code as code from batch.job_step_instance s where s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and s.job_instance_id = latest.job_instance_id and s.step_status in ('RUNNING','WAITING','RETRYING') and not exists ( select 1 from batch.pipeline_instance p where p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and p.related_job_instance_id = latest.job_instance_id ) ) active ) current_steps on true
